extracted.name: Tuna Pizza
extracted.description: This tuna pizza recipe uses a pre-baked pizza crust with cream cheese, canned tuna, red onion, and mozzarella cheese, then bakes until bubbly and golden.
ingredient_lines: 1 (5 ounce) can tuna, drained and flaked
crushed red pepper flakes, or to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Spread cream cheese onto crust; sprinkle with tuna and onions, then top with mozzarella cheese and pepper flakes.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese melts and starts to brown, 15 to 20 minutes.
